evidence.quote: The program is offered entirely in English.

notes: Tuition left out: the only figures found are the institution-wide annual amount for first-year Bachelor of Science students (17,000 EUR/year on https://www.unibocconi.it/it/studenti-iscritti/tasse-e-contributi-universitari) and Master of Science amounts; no quote states one tuition amount specifically for a non-EU applicant with a foreign diploma living abroad for this programme. Application channel left out: no supplied page names Universitaly or the university's own application portal for this programme; the apply.unibocconi.it page names the DreamApply platform but gives no deadlines for the International category and does not state the route in the terms required.
